checks.evidence: The independent review binds exactly the adapter and existing publisher and a selected inventory. Payload is limited to4096 files,64MiB per input and512MiB selected aggregate. No filesystem walk is used.

Each selected input is owned by the project or the exact external owner-report directory, has no forbidden private/environment/Git path component or symlink, is regular and single-link, and is read through bounded O_NOFOLLOW fd I/O. Identity uses device/inode/mode/link count/size/mtime/ctime, excluding access time, and exact digest/length are checked.

Selected archive paths must be relative, contain no parent traversal or publisher-excluded component, and be unique. manifest.json and the automatically added review path are refused before the publisher reservation. JSON/JSONL pass the existing public-field exclusion check.

The adapter imports only standard library modules and executes only exact pinned publisher bytes in a separate module. The selected _build path constructs/verifies a tar/checksum and checks a local delivery receipt; it performs no application/native/model import, provider call, network access or Git operation.

The existing publisher writes an exclusive permanent build reservation, creates a new timestamped archive, validates complete tar manifest/hash/size contents, fsyncs, atomically publishes checksum and retains local/delivery observations. It neither overwrites prior returns nor authorizes an uncertain retry.

Delivery waits at most30 seconds for a local operator receipt and rechecks the actual external archive/checksum pair. Absent or invalid delivery evidence remains unconfirmed rather than being claimed delivered.

claim_boundaries: Packaging conveys no semantic or runtime acceptance.
No Git/public push, owner scenario, native E, effects or model execution is granted.
No archive was built or publisher executed during this review.
required_grant_checks: The final independent reviewer must pin and inspect the actual selection and review metadata, including normalized nonempty archive paths, secret-free file classification, source/actual evidence scope and prior-archive identities. This source review does not choose payload files or authorize execution.
The bootstrap review file must be the expected regular owned small file with the supplied independent SHA. The adapter treats the authenticated local review as its bootstrap input.
Invoke the exact reviewed adapter with -B. Keep publisher source unchanged and use only the one independently granted local return invocation.
Payload text/raw evidence and external owner reports require classification in the finite selection; this adapter is not a general secret detector.

resolved_findings.repair: Bounded fd read with O_NOFOLLOW and stable identity excluding atime.
Reject manifest.json and the generated review archive name before the one-use publisher reservation.
Reject local_operator, local_operator_private, .settings, .env and .env.* source components before reads.
